package.name: lowlevel_control
package.description: REAL joint impedance controller: tau = tau_ff + Kp(q_d-q) + Kd(qd_d-qd), implemented as a real ros2_control controller_interface plugin running inside controller_manager's 1000 Hz real-time update() loop. Identical whether the loaded hardware plugin is mujoco_ros2_control/MujocoSystem (sim) or ethercat_bridge/EthercatHardwareInterface (real hardware). See README.md and ARCHITECTURE.md "Sim/hardware symmetry".
